summary: STMicroelectronics filed a Form 6-K disclosing a routine weekly update of its ongoing share repurchase program, originally announced June 2024 and approved by shareholders in May 2024. During the period July 13-17, 2026, the company repurchased 199,413 ordinary shares on Euronext Paris at an average price of EUR 57.2549 per share for total consideration of approximately EUR 11.4 million. The program is intended to meet obligations from employee share option plans and other allocations. This is a standard open-market buyback disclosure, not a special situation. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or structural complexity is involved; the filing merely satisfies regulatory reporting requirements under the Market Abuse Regulation. There is no risk-arb angle; ongoing buybacks are a routine capital return mechanism.
